description: wigolo test/run environment: Bun 1.4 (primary runtime/package manager) + Node 22 (pkg binary channel only) + the runtime libraries Playwright Chromium needs on NixOS.

init_hook: # NixOS has no /usr/lib, so Playwright's bundled Chromium cannot find its
# runtime libraries. devbox's own package farm drops glib's and dbus's
# /lib — the two it needs most — so the set comes from a buildEnv in
# devbox.d/playwright-libs. Guarded: the flake only defines x86_64-linux,
# and pointing LD_LIBRARY_PATH at it elsewhere would poison every child.

scripts.test: bun scripts/check-native.mjs || bun install --force; bun run build && bunx vitest run
scripts.test:integration: bun scripts/check-native.mjs || bun install --force; bun run build && bunx vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: bun scripts/check-native.mjs || bun install --force; bun run build && bunx vitest run tests/e2e
